_schema.mu_peak: peak tyre–road friction coefficient (max grip just before sliding)
_schema.ui_default: single value used by the app's surface presets and by illustration 05

surfaces.label: Dry asphalt
surfaces.note: Motorcycle tyres on dry surfaces: peak ≈1.2, locked 0.7–0.9 (SAE/TRL). Generic tyre tables give 0.80–0.90 peak (hpwizard).

surfaces.label: Gravel (compacted)
surfaces.note: Limited by gravel sliding on gravel, not by the tyre — knobbies help by digging in, not by raising this ceiling much.

surfaces.label: Loose gravel / sand
surfaces.note: Indicative only (rider-training source, not a measurement).

modifiers_not_quantified: Cold tyres and cold road reduce μ (direction known, size not quantified here).
Pressure above spec shrinks the contact patch and stiffens knobs; below spec overheats the carcass.
Knobby (60/40) tyres on tarmac: fewer rubber blocks in contact at lean, block squirm — no published μ found.
Worn, squared-off rear: edge contact early in the lean, then a sudden transition onto the shoulder.
